findings.claim: 公司 10-K 揭露：部分不同產品在某些情況下可替代其成品。
findings.excerpt: Furthermore, a number of different products may, in certain instances, be substituted for our finished products.

findings.claim: 公司 10-K 風險因子：較低成本替代材料持續可得，客戶可能轉用較低成本替代品，造成業績大幅波動。
findings.excerpt: In addition, continued availability of lower cost, substitute materials may cause significant fluctuations in future results as our customers opt for a lower cost alternative.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋未找到 2026 年具體替代技術取代 CRS 產品或市占流失的第三方來源；僅有公司自身風險揭露。
